build_sphinx_docs: build sphinx documentation for the OpenSpiel project using the conf.py configuration
configure_sphinx_extensions: configure sphinx extensions including autodoc, intersphinx, todo, and markdown support
set_html_theme_options: set sphinx html theme options for navigation and output customization

setup_intersphinx_mapping: setup intersphinx mapping to link external python documentation references
